measures.name: 静的寄附総額
measures.dax: CALCULATE([寄附総額], KEEPFILTERS('寄附'[データソース] = "StaticSeed"))

measures.name: 静的寄附件数
measures.dax: CALCULATE([寄附件数], KEEPFILTERS('寄附'[データソース] = "StaticSeed"))

measures.name: 受入増分寄附総額
measures.dax: CALCULATE([寄附総額], KEEPFILTERS('寄附'[データソース] = "RealtimeIncrement"))

measures.name: 受入増分寄附件数
measures.dax: CALCULATE([寄附件数], KEEPFILTERS('寄附'[データソース] = "RealtimeIncrement"))
